mapper.select: WITH class_rows AS ( SELECT one_class_no AS class_no, one_class_name AS class_name, '0' AS parent_class_no, 1 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE one_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(one_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT two_class_no AS class_no, two_class_name AS class_name, one_class_no AS parent_class_no, 2 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE two_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(two_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT three_class_no AS class_no, three_class_name AS class_name, two_class_no AS parent_class_no, 3 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE three_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(three_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT four_class_no AS class_no, four_class_name AS class_name, three_class_no AS parent_class_no, 4 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE four_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(four_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT five_class_no AS class_no, five_class_name AS class_name, four_class_no AS parent_class_no, 5 AS class_level FROM base_class WHERE five_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(five_class_no)) <> '' ) SELECT DISTINCT class_no AS classNo, class_name AS className, parent_class_no AS parentClassNo, class_level AS classLevel FROM class_rows WHERE class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(class_no)) <> '' ORDER BY class_level, class_no

SELECT s.class_no AS classNo, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_sku)), '')), 0)) AS INT) AS suggestSaleSku, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_sku)), '')), 0)) AS INT) AS sysSuggestSaleSku, MAX(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_role))) AS roleNo FROM base_class_sku s LEFT JOIN base_department d ON d.store_no = s.store_no WHERE s.class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.class_no)) <> ''
GROUP BY s.class_no

WITH filtered_products AS ( SELECT p.* FROM base_dept_products p LEFT JOIN base_department d ON d.store_no = p.store_no WHERE 1 = 1
), class_products AS ( SELECT one_class_no AS class_no, product_no FROM filtered_products WHERE one_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(one_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT two_class_no AS class_no, product_no FROM filtered_products WHERE two_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(two_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT three_class_no AS class_no, product_no FROM filtered_products WHERE three_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(three_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT four_class_no AS class_no, product_no FROM filtered_products WHERE four_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(four_class_no)) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT five_class_no AS class_no, product_no FROM filtered_products WHERE five_class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(five_class_no)) <> '' ) SELECT class_no AS classNo, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT product_no) AS INT) AS saleSku FROM class_products WHERE class_no IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(class_no)) <> '' GROUP BY class_no

SELECT d.dict_code AS dictCode, t.dict_id AS dictId, d.dict_sort AS dictSort, d.dict_label AS dictLabel, d.dict_value AS dictValue, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), d.create_time, 120) AS createTime FROM sys_dict_data d LEFT JOIN sys_dict_type t ON t.dict_type = d.dict_type AND t.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = N'000000' AND d.dict_type = #{dictType} ORDER BY d.dict_sort ASC, d.dict_code ASC
